MIZAN GROUP — BOARD PACK EXCERPT (STRICTLY CONFIDENTIAL)
Tamween Pharma Distribution — FY2025 performance review
Prepared by: BU Finance, January 2026 | Scope: BU total, with Central Region division detail

1. HEADLINES
- BU revenue SAR 2,340M (+10.4%). EBITDA 6.8% (+40bps) — below the 7.5% integration case.
- Central Region division: net revenue SAR 697M (+10.1% gross, +10.1% net). Growth is NUPCO-led.
- Margin compression risk flagged: cost lines growing faster than gross margin.

2. REVENUE (Central Region division)
- Government +SAR 52M: NUPCO full-year effect. Now 27% of division revenue (2023: 20%) — concentration accepted for volume, but framework pricing dilutes gross margin ~90bps.
- Modern Pharmacy -SAR 7M: Red Sea Global Healthcare churned June (full-year value ~SAR 38M). Pricing grid rebuild still outstanding.
- Workforce Health +SAR 10M gross; KAUST rebates SAR 8.2M (12% retro) — account is contribution-negative after logistics cost-to-serve and 100+ day effective collections. Renegotiation mandate requested.

3. COST PRESSURES (the margin story)
- COGS ratio 19.2% of net revenue (2023: 18.0%): generics price erosion + specialty mix + EUR at 4.05-4.12 unhedged (hedge programme approved December 2025, live 2026).
- Packaging: Hijaz Pharma Solutions PKG-1101 unit price SAR 9.16 (+19% cumulative since 2023 vs CPI ~4%) — sole-sourced since 2023, re-tender recommended.
- Cold-chain 3PL: CT-2023-014 auto-renewed 2 October at CPI+3% uncapped -> 2026 rate SAR 229,736/month (+22.2%). Renegotiation window missed (90-day notice lapsed).
- Payroll +9%: pharmacist Saudisation premiums; headcount +6%.
- AP discipline: early-pay discount capture ceased September (clerk departure, no backfill); Premier Pharma duplicate-payment query (Nov, SAR 96.6K) unresolved at year-end.

4. 2026 PRIORITIES
- Internal Audit payables review Q1-2026 (now scheduled — the "cash leakage" audit).
- KAUST contribution renegotiation; Modern Pharmacy pricing grid; Hijaz re-tender; cold-chain contract renegotiation.
- FX hedge programme live January 2026 (60% EUR coverage target).
